title: RegionAgent: Two-Stage Preference Optimization for Regional Image Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2611.26179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Images under non-uniform coupled degradations require diverse restoration capabilities for different degraded regions. Existing methods employ globally uniform operations, potentially overlooking regional differences and causing incomplete restoration or even damage to image content. Moreover, a degraded region may require successive restoration actions, and earlier actions may alter residual degradation characteristics or introduce artifacts, potentially hindering subsequent restoration. To address these challenges, we propose RegionAgent, an adaptive restoration framework that trains a Vision-Language Model (VLM) through two-stage preference learning to generate a region-specific restoration action at each iteration. Specifically, we first train the VLM to select an action suited to the current region through step-level Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), using preferences derived from immediate restoration feedback to supervise on

translated_title: RegionAgent：面向区域图像修复的两阶段偏好优化
translated_abstract: 非均匀耦合退化下的图像需要针对不同退化区域具备多样化的修复能力。现有方法采用全局统一的操作，可能忽视区域间的差异，导致修复不完整甚至损坏图像内容。此外，一个退化区域可能需要连续执行多个修复动作，而较早的动作可能改变残余退化特征或引入伪影，从而阻碍后续修复。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了RegionAgent，这是一种自适应修复框架，通过两阶段偏好学习训练视觉语言模型（VLM），在每次迭代中生成针对特定区域的修复动作。具体而言，我们首先通过步骤级直接偏好优化（DPO）训练VLM选择适合当前区域的动作，并利用从即时修复反馈中获得的偏好进行监督……
tldr: 提出RegionAgent自适应修复框架，通过两阶段偏好学习训练视觉语言模型，在每次迭代中针对非均匀耦合退化的不同区域自适应生成特定的修复动作，克服了现有全局统一操作忽视区域差异、修复不完整的问题。
en_tdlr: RegionAgent is an adaptive image restoration framework that trains a Vision-Language Model through two-stage preference optimization to generate region-specific restoration actions at each iteration, effectively handling non-uniform coupled degradations where globally uniform methods fail.
